verdict.rationale: Bench explicitly delivers income statements (P&L) and balance sheets in real-time, downloadable, with custom periods (real-time, monthly, quarterly, yearly), and markets these for proving profitability to banks/investors. Bookkeeping is handled by combination of automation plus human bookkeepers ensuring accuracy, positioned as the core value proposition. Missing for 10: explicit, named cash-flow statement is not directly evidenced (only P&L and balance sheet are named), and no independent/third-party verification of report accuracy.
